svg.title: Alpha: v0.2.0-alpha1 — read the entire README before use
svg.desc: One basic Twitch test passed with x264; YouTube and Kick untested. v0.2.0-alpha1 is x264 only; NVIDIA NVENC support is on main for the next alpha. Use the Active Live Delay dock, not OBS's normal Start Streaming button.

g.text: ALPHA: v0.2.0-alpha1 — READ THE ENTIRE README BEFORE USE
ONE BASIC TWITCH TEST PASSED (x264) — YOUTUBE AND KICK UNTESTED
v0.2.0-alpha1 IS x264 ONLY — NVIDIA NVENC SUPPORT IS ON MAIN FOR THE NEXT ALPHA
TEST WITH A NON-CRITICAL STREAM FIRST
Use the Active Live Delay dock, not OBS Start Streaming.
